summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing completion of a cross-holding unwinding with ISA Energia Brasil S.A. in Brazilian transmission SPEs. AXIA sold its 49% stakes in IE Madeira to ISA Energia and acquired ISA's 51% stake in IE Garanhuns, receiving net proceeds of R$1.167 billion. AXIA now fully consolidates IE Garanhuns; ISA consolidates IE Madeira. The transaction followed conditions precedent disclosed March 19, 2026. No advisors or share prices were disclosed. Watch: consolidation effects on AXIA's revenue and potential further asset rationalization.
